id.title: ID
id.description: SHA-256 of (politician, transaction_date, asset_name, amount_min, amount_max, source_id). Unique per row — changes if source_id changes.

source_id.title: Source document ID
source_id.description: The source PTR's DocID plus the row's ordinal within it (house_<DocID>_<row_index>), or house_<DocID>_fetch_failed / house_<DocID>_scanned / house_<DocID>_parse_failed for the three placeholder kinds.

filing_id.title: Filing ID
filing_id.description: The filing's own DocID, shared by every row and placeholder from this one filing — unlike source_id, which is per-row and therefore different for a placeholder (one row per filing) versus real transaction rows (one row per line item). Used to recognize when a later run's real rows supersede a stale placeholder for the same filing.

content_hash.title: Content hash
content_hash.description: SHA-256 of (politician, transaction_date, asset_name, type, amount_min, amount_max, owner) — source_id excluded. Rows sharing this within the same document are legitimate separate tranches; rows sharing it across different documents are the same real-world transaction reported twice. Never used to drop or merge rows — see actor README.

filing_type.title: Filing type
filing_type.description: Read from the PTR's own per-row "Filing Status: New/Amended" line. Null only when that line is missing — never inferred from duplicate documents.

amendment_number.title: Amendment number
amendment_number.description: Always null on this actor — schema parity with the Senate actor's "(Amendment N)" label, which has no equivalent in the House source (House only exposes a New/Amended flag, not a number).

row_index_in_filing.title: Row index in filing
row_index_in_filing.description: 0-based position of this row among its filing's parsed data rows, in source order. Tells apart repeated line items inside one filing (which share a content_hash). Not part of id or content_hash. 0 on a placeholder row (a filing's only row).

supersedes_filing_id.title: Supersedes filing ID
supersedes_filing_id.description: On an amended filing's rows: the filing_id of the earlier filing by the same filer that it re-lists trades from. The House source has no explicit amends-link, so this is only set where shared identical trades make it determinable; otherwise null.

is_superseded.title: Is superseded
is_superseded.description: True on the surviving rows of a filing that a later amended filing supersedes by the rule described under supersedes_filing_id.

parse_status.title: Parse status
parse_status.description: 'ok' for a normally-parsed row. 'fetch_failed' means the PDF download itself failed after retries — the filing's content was never examined; transient, superseded automatically once a later run's fetch succeeds for the same filing. 'scanned_unparsed' means this filing's PDF has no extractable text layer at all (a scanned/paper PTR) — no OCR template recognized it, or OCR was attempted and a row failed validation. 'parse_failed' means the PDF DOES have a text layer and transaction markers were found, but no row matched the expected amount/date/type-code shape — a parser gap. 'ocr' means the filing was recovered via OCR (see ocr_confidence) — every row in the filing passed validation. Every non-'ok'/'ocr' status is a placeholder: every transaction-detail field (transaction_date, ticker, asset_name, asset_type, asset_subtype, type, amount_min, amount_max, owner) is null, and pdf_url points at the source PDF. No filing is ever silently dropped from output.

pdf_url.title: Source PDF URL
pdf_url.description: URL of the House PTR PDF this row was parsed from (or, for a placeholder row, the PDF that couldn't be fetched/read/matched).

fetchedAt.title: Fetched at
fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this row was first pulled from source. Immutable once set — a re-fetch of an unchanged row never updates it. If the source later revises this filing row, the new row carries this timestamp forward from the prior version, so 'first seen' survives the revision.

lastModifiedAt.title: Last modified at
lastModifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this row's content was last observed to change. Equals fetchedAt for a first-seen row.

revisionCount.title: Revision count
revisionCount.description: Number of content revisions detected for this source document/row lineage. 0 for a first-seen row; incremented each time the source republishes this row with different content.

politician.title: Politician
politician.description: Filer name as the House Clerk index prints it. A doubled token in the source ("Scott Scott Franklin") is collapsed ("Scott Franklin"); see politician_raw.

politician_raw.title: Politician (raw)
politician_raw.description: The filer name exactly as the House index printed it (First Last Suffix), before normalization.

member_bioguide_id.title: Member bioguide ID
member_bioguide_id.description: Bioguide id from unitedstates/congress-legislators, resolved from the filer name (same roster approach as the Senate actor). Null when the filer is not a current House member or the name matches more than one — never guessed.

transaction_date.title: Transaction date
transaction_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the trade was executed. Null on a placeholder row ('scanned_unparsed' or 'parse_failed').

filing_date.title: Filing date
filing_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the PTR was filed with the House Clerk.

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: Stock ticker as given by the source, cleaned of artifacts. Null when the source omits it (common for government securities/munis, bank notes, private funds and some stocks) or gave a company-name abbreviation instead of a ticker. Never guessed or looked up.

asset_name.title: Asset name
asset_name.description: Full asset description as reported on the PTR. Null on a placeholder row ('scanned_unparsed' or 'parse_failed').

asset_type.title: Asset type
asset_type.description: House asset classification. Null on a placeholder row ('scanned_unparsed' or 'parse_failed').

asset_subtype.title: Asset subtype
asset_subtype.description: Derived directly from the source PDF's own asset-type marker code (ET → 'ETF', MF → 'Mutual Fund') — a direct source signal, unlike the Senate actor's name-text guess. Null for every other asset_type, and on a placeholder row ('scanned_unparsed' or 'parse_failed').

type.title: Trade type
type.description: Normalized to 'buy' (Purchase), 'sell' (Sale Full / Sale Partial), or 'exchange' (asset type code [E] — an asset swap, e.g. a called security or merger conversion — reported by the source as its own transaction type, not a buy or sell). Null on a placeholder row ('scanned_unparsed' or 'parse_failed').

amount_min.title: Amount lower bound
amount_min.description: Lower bound of the reported amount range, in USD. Usually a whole dollar disclosure bracket, but a single exact-amount disclosure can carry cents (e.g. 2722.5). Null on a placeholder row ('scanned_unparsed' or 'parse_failed').

amount_max.title: Amount upper bound
amount_max.description: Upper bound of the reported amount range, in USD. Usually a whole dollar disclosure bracket, but a single exact-amount disclosure can carry cents (e.g. 2722.5). Null for unbounded 'Over $X' brackets, and on a placeholder row ('scanned_unparsed' or 'parse_failed').

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Account owner classification per STOCK Act. Null on a placeholder row ('scanned_unparsed' or 'parse_failed').

overview.title: Transaction overview
overview.description: Compact view — politician, ticker, type, amounts, dates.

full.title: Full record
full.description: All fields including asset_name, asset_type, id, source_id, content_hash, and filing_type.
